name: xWays Hoarder 2

features.name: xWays
features.description: Reveal symbols on the middle reels.

features.name: xSplit Wilds
features.description: Split and double everything to their left.

review:
xWays Hoarder 2 is a 6x3 bunker sequel. xWays land on the four middle reels and reveal a random symbol. xSplit Wilds on any reel except the first split every symbol to their left on the same row and double it, and xSplit Nudge symbols land as stacks.

Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, with a 25,920x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
